items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Script verifies docs/_smoke/unit-2.md exists and is non-empty; doc and test created; test placed in shared/tests (no repo-root tests/ root exists, one-test-root rule) - deviation recorded in the ADR.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing path, non-file path, unreadable/invalid UTF-8 and whitespace-only content all return (False, message) and exit 1; no traceback paths.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Read-only stdlib script; no secrets, no shell, no network; --project-root only selects a read location.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 9 tests cover each failure branch, success, in-process main() exit codes and two real subprocess round-trips (explicit root and cwd-independent default).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single small file read; no loops or I/O fan-out.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Leading-underscore names mark the throwaway smoke files; check()/main() split mirrors other repo scripts; no dead code.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: One boundary: committed markdown file -> script reader. Round-trip probe run (subprocess reads the committed doc, exit 0); BOM tolerated via utf-8-sig, invalid bytes fail cleanly.
